title: Official Notification Bridge Provider Extensibility
problem: The notification bridge has two working providers, but provider orchestration, diagnostics, and future test-send behavior are still route-local and will not scale cleanly to more providers.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-notification-bridge provider health diagnostics --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p nako-notification-bridge test_send provider diagnostics --no-fail-fast

evidence.summary: Opened provider-extensibility lane, scoped registry seam, safe test-send, and provider extension proof tasks.

Added provider_registry seam for provider diagnostics, configuration status, selected-provider output, and generic attempt-history mapping. Routes now consume registry facts while preserving HTTP and Discord webhook behavior; targeted/package nextest, clippy, fmt, and diff gates passed.

non_goals: provider retry queues or scheduler ownership
raw secret or payload exposure in diagnostics

continue_policy.notes: Continue with safe provider test-send. Split concrete Telegram/Home Assistant/email provider implementation if the registry/test-send scope grows.
